name: Philip Ismail
profile_text: Philip Ismail Software Engineer. Skills: Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, C, C++, React, Next.js, FastAPI, REST APIs, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, Vite, AWS Lambda, S3, Glue, Athena, CloudFormation, IAM, CloudWatch, EventBridge, Bedrock, Amazon Q, boto3, Terraform, Anthropic Claude API, DynamoDB, Firebase Firestore, Git, Linux, macOS, Vercel, Render. Lead a 50-person team across Inbound Receive operations, processing an average of 30,000+ units daily while coordinating cross-functionally with Stow to maintain real-time shift-level receive/stow balance. Own the PID throughput metric on a 2,400-carton/hour line; drove blocks-and-starvation reduction through real-time dashboard monitoring and an Alexa-based live alert integration, increasing sustained throughput from a ~700/hour baseline to 1,000+/hour. Automated a manual hourly balance-reporting process by building a data pull from an enterprise warehouse database, reducing report generation time from 5 minutes to under 30 seconds. Architected and deployed a serverless data pipeline using AWS Lambda, S3, Glue, Athena, EventBridge Scheduler, CloudFormation to automate retrieval and centralized analysis of AWS Marketplace subscription data across multi-account organizations, expanding usage and cost visibility from 70% to 100%. Integrated Amazon Q Business and built an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base to enable natural-language querying of Marketplace subscription insights, extending the platform into GenAI-driven analytics. Presented end-to-end solution and business impact at AWS Scale CoE Quarterly Business Review, translating technical architecture decisions into stakeholder-facing recommendations on licensing usage and spend optimization. Architected a full-stack media discovery platform using React and FastAPI with 17 REST endpoints spanning content aggregation across TMDB, Google Books, and Deezer APIs, chat, and saved favorites CRUD, serving 4 core views through a shared component library. Integrated Anthropic Claude API with structured tool-use to generate natural-language-driven recommendations, paired with a poster-availability filter on TMDB results. Engineered for resilience under real third-party failure conditions with debounced search input and retry-with-backoff logic. Architected a graph-based AWS network topology tool that translates live VPC, subnet, and route table data into a queryable node/edge graph model enabling connectivity tracing programmatically. Provisioned a full Terraform-based test environment representing a known-good network topology. Designed a dependency-free, pure Python AWS-response translation layer decoupled from live boto3 calls, laying groundwork for fixture-based testing and automated reachability analysis. Bachelor of Science Computer Engineering University of Maryland. Master of Science Management Studies University of Maryland.
